Dmitri: Starting micro-canary for v3.2.1 -> 10% on /generate. Change window 2026-03-22 22:00 UTC. Deploybot will announce steps.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release=v3.2.1 traffic=10% route=/generate pool=infra-pool-b id=r-1762349999
```
apply rollout r-1762349999
deploy --release v3.2.1 --canary=10
```

Carla: Obs ask: watch p95/p99, 5xx rate, and token drop anomalies. Dash: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1762349999

Alice: Config pinned on route: { service: llm-gen, model: v3.2.1 } — release notes updated in PR.

deploy-bot: Canary applied. Performing automated smoke checks (latency, errors, memory). Reporting periodic signals.

Eva: Early signal: p95 +30ms, p99 unchanged. Memory RSS on a subset of pods higher by ~18%. kv-cache miss ratio jittering.

Nikhil: I'll tail heap profiles. If we see mmap failures or OOM, call immediate stop.

Dmitri: Stop criteria reminder: 5xx >0.7% sustained 3m OR p95 delta >120ms 5m OR any "mmap: failed"/"kv cache OOM" logged -> stop. Auto-stop enabled.

monitor-bot: SIGNAL r-1762349999: 5xx=0.9% (2m), top error="mmap failed: cannot allocate memory" on infra-pool-b-04. Logs: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/r-1762349999

Bob: That's above threshold. SRE: recommend manual stop and rollback to v3.2.0.

Carla: Manual STOP from eng-sre. Rollback plan: route revert to v3.2.0, drain canary pods, scale down canary ASG, lock new image.

deploy-bot: Manual STOP acknowledged by @Carla. Running rollback commands:
```
route set /generate --version=3.2.0
scale deployment llm-gen-v3.2.1 --replicas=0
asg update infra-pool-b --desired=0 --tag=canary
```

Dmitri: Confirmed. Opening follow-up ticket for memory allocation regression (tracker #R-4821). Will include heap dumps and kv-cache metrics.

Alice: Update release notes: "Canary v3.2.1 rolled back due to memory allocation failures and increased 5xx. Reverted to v3.2.0." Tagging: rollback, infra, canary.

Nikhil: I'll attach heap profiles and a quick diff of allocator traces before the 22:30 triage.

Carla: Scheduling quick post-rollback sync 2026-03-22 22:30 UTC. Owners: @Carla, @Eva, @Nikhil. Thanks everyone for fast reaction. :handshake:

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Route now -> 3.2.0. Canary pool scaled down. State=ROLLED_BACK.
